name: Pearcedale PO - Optional Test Storage V2

parameters.jsCode: const d=$input.first().json; if(d.schema_version!=='po-test.v2'||d.status!=='passed'||d.inventory_is_simulated!==true||d.submission_allowed!==false||!Array.isArray(d.forecasts)||!Array.isArray(d.recommendations)||!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(d.run_id)) throw new Error('Invalid test storage input'); return [{json:d}];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO po_testing.runs AS stored (run_id, payload)
VALUES (($1::jsonb)->>'run_id', $1::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET payload = stored.payload
RETURNING run_id,
  CASE WHEN payload = $1::jsonb THEN 'stored' ELSE 'conflict' END AS storage_status;
